# What the Toys Cannot Show {#sec-toy-limits}

::: {.callout-warning title="Stub"}
Assembled in Phase 4 from every chapter's "What the toy cannot show" section.
:::

Every result in this book is computed on a small synthetic testbed. This appendix will collect,
in one place, what those computations do not settle: scale, real data, wall-clock cost, and
behavior of real architectures.
